policies.n: An advance short-stay visa is required. Authorised stay is set by the visa, subject to the Schengen-wide 90/180-day maximum. Apply through the competent mission/visa centre; online form submission does not by itself establish an eVisa. Short tourism only. The Schengen limit is 90 days in any rolling 180-day period across the whole area, not 90 days per country. Passport issued within the previous 10 years and valid at least three months after intended departure; accommodation, funds and return/onward travel may be checked. ETIAS is not operational at this check; EES border registration is not an advance travel authorisation.

Short tourism only. The Schengen limit is 90 days in any rolling 180-day period across the whole area, not 90 days per country. Passport issued within the previous 10 years and valid at least three months after intended departure; accommodation, funds and return/onward travel may be checked. ETIAS is not operational at this check; EES border registration is not an advance travel authorisation. Visa exemption requires a biometric passport; non-biometric documents do not qualify. Passport recognition: As of 1 March 2012, non-biometric passports are no longer recognised

policies.label: Schengen visa needed for access
policies.n: Andorra requires no local visa for any nationality, but it can only be reached through France or Spain. Where a Schengen visa is required, obtain it before travel with at least two entries for return to Schengen, or multiple entries for repeated visits. Entering Andorra leaves Schengen; it does not reset the Schengen 90/180-day allowance. No Andorran stay length is asserted from this source. EU citizens may use a valid ID/passport; other visitors need a valid passport. Schengen access remains subject to the area-wide 90 days in any rolling 180-day period; this is not a separate allowance in each access country. Passport recognition: Non-machine-readable ORDINARY passport not recognised

Passport recognition: Recognised only if place of birth is entered

policies.stay: Up to 3 months, at the immigration officer’s discretion
policies.n: Ireland has its own visa regime: a Schengen visa does not itself grant Irish entry. Permission and duration are decided at the Irish border, up to a maximum of three months; carry passport, itinerary, accommodation, sufficient funds and health insurance. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. Apply for an Irish short-stay C visa in advance; AVATS is an online application form, not proof of an electronic visa issued without document submission.

policies.stay: Up to 3 months, at the immigration officer’s discretion
policies.n: Ireland has its own visa regime: a Schengen visa does not itself grant Irish entry. Permission and duration are decided at the Irish border, up to a maximum of three months; carry passport, itinerary, accommodation, sufficient funds and health insurance. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed.

EU/EEA/Swiss free-movement rights apply, with a valid passport or eligible national identity card. This is not the third-country Schengen 90/180-day visitor waiver. Longer residence can require registration, sufficient resources and health insurance; Liechtenstein has special residence conditions.

Permission and duration are decided at the Irish border, up to a maximum of three months; carry passport, itinerary, accommodation, sufficient funds and health insurance. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. Hong Kong SAR passports are exempt; the Hong Kong Document of Identity requires a visa.

policies.stay: Up to 3 months, at the immigration officer’s discretion
policies.n: Ireland has its own visa regime: a Schengen visa does not itself grant Irish entry. policies.stay: Up to 3 months, at the immigration officer’s discretion

No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. The Irish nationality table exempts Taiwan; no Schengen identity-card-number condition is imported into Irish policy.

British citizens have Common Travel Area travel rights. Carry evidence of identity and British citizenship. These rights do not extend to other British nationality classes or other nationals merely resident in the UK.

Ordinary biometric passports qualify; non-biometric passports need a Cypriot visa. Maximum 90 days in any 180-day period in Cyprus, separate from the Schengen allowance. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points (Larnaca/Paphos airports or authorised seaports); passport must meet Cyprus validity requirements. ETIAS is not operational at this check.

EU/EEA/Swiss free-movement rights apply, with a valid passport or eligible national identity card. This is not the third-country Schengen 90/180-day visitor waiver. Longer residence can require registration, sufficient resources and health insurance; Liechtenstein has special residence conditions.

A Cypriot short-stay visa is required before tourist travel. Visa validity is not the permitted stay; check the issued authorisation (maximum 90/180 days). Turkish/Azerbaijani nationals do not benefit from the general recognition of Schengen visas/residence permits. Follow the competent mission’s procedure, including pre-approval where required, and use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points. The Washington mission states electronic submission is not available.

British citizens may visit for up to 90 days in a 180-day period, counted separately from Schengen. Passport issued within 10 years, valid three months after departure; return/onward ticket and funds may be requested. Enter via lawful Republic of Cyprus ports; entry through the north can be treated as illegal. ETIAS is not operational.

An advance Cypriot short-stay visa is required under Article 3 and Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806. Duration is set by the issued visa within the 90/180-day Cyprus maximum; visa validity is not the permitted stay. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

Ordinary national passport exemption under Article 4 and Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806. Up to 90 days in any 180-day period in Cyprus, counted separately from Schengen. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

Ordinary national passport exemption under Article 4 and Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806. Up to 90 days in any 180-day period in Cyprus, counted separately from Schengen. Only Hong Kong SAR passports qualify, not other Hong Kong travel documents. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

Only Região Administrativa Especial de Macau passports qualify. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

An advance Cypriot short-stay visa is required under Article 3 and Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806. Duration is set by the issued visa within the 90/180-day Cyprus maximum; visa validity is not the permitted stay. The Annex I entry is the Palestinian Authority; this establishes the visa requirement, not acceptance of every Palestinian/refugee travel-document variant. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

Ordinary national passport exemption under Article 4 and Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806. Up to 90 days in any 180-day period in Cyprus, counted separately from Schengen. Visa exemption requires an ICAO-compliant biometric passport. Regulation (EU) 2024/2495 explicitly includes biometric Serbian Coordination Directorate passports and expressly covers Cyprus; the London mission’s older exclusion is superseded. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

Ordinary national passport exemption under Article 4 and Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806. Up to 90 days in any 180-day period in Cyprus, counted separately from Schengen. Exemption requires a Taiwan passport containing an identity-card number. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

An advance Cypriot short-stay visa is required under Article 3 and Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806. Duration is set by the issued visa within the 90/180-day Cyprus maximum; visa validity is not the permitted stay. Regulation (EU) 2025/11 moved Vanuatu to Annex I; it expressly covers Cyprus and entered into force on 3 February 2025. This is not a time-limited waiver. Carry a passport recognised by Cyprus, issued within 10 years and valid at least three months beyond departure. Use lawful Republic of Cyprus entry points; accommodation, funds, return/onward travel and insurance evidence may be required. Where a visa is required, Cyprus issues a national visa through a consular application rather than an electronic visa. No third-country visa or residence permit is assumed. ETIAS was not operational in the inspected guidance.

Seychellois ordinary national passports are visa-exempt for the standard Schengen allowance of up to 90 days in any 180-day period. The original German-language Foreign Office table lists Seychellen: Nein (1), without a biometric footnote, consistent with statutory Annex II and the EU recognition matrix. The English translation’s biometric annotation is erroneous. Passport issued within the previous 10 years and valid at least three months after intended departure; usual funds/accommodation/return-travel conditions apply.

policies.label: Visa required; unrecognised-passport procedure
policies.n: Dutch government guidance explicitly accepts Somali-national visitor applications, with applications by Somalia residents handled at VFS Nairobi and a usual 45-day decision period. The EU recognition matrix does not recognise the Somali ordinary passport in the Netherlands. Under Visa Code Article 25(3), a visa issued by a state that does not recognise the travel document is valid only for that state; Article 29(2) requires a separate visa sheet. Confirm the issued territorial/document authorisation and the travel route with the Dutch mission before travel; a visa from another Schengen state is not presumed sufficient. The permitted days are those authorised, not an automatic 90 days or the processing period. The current Somali visa measure normally permits only one entry. Visa issue and admission remain individual decisions.

policies.label: Non-essential tourist entry restricted
policies.n: For ordinary tourism and non-essential transit into Finland, the Finnish MFA states that Russian holders of Schengen visas are subject to entry restrictions, in force until further notice. A tourist visa alone does not remove the restriction. Its published exceptions cover qualifying family, work, transport, business, study, treatment, property, diplomatic and other essential purposes; none is assumed here. This is the non-essential entry rule, not a ban on every Russian person or a ruling on an independently lawful intra-Schengen/residence situation. Finnish passport-recognition rules also generally require a biometric Russian passport from 1 June 2026, with specified age, existing-permit and transitional exceptions.

policies.label: Tourist entry barred at external border
policies.n: Cabinet Regulation 123 permits Russian entry across Latvia’s external border only in listed residence/long-stay-visa, family, humanitarian, transport, seafarer, diplomatic and related categories. Ordinary tourism without such an exception is not permitted even with a short-stay visa. This external-border restriction is not extended to travel already lawfully inside Schengen; the MFA FAQ distinguishes internal-Schengen travel. No existing visa/residence right is assumed. The regulation is currently in force through 31 December 2026; recheck thereafter. Russian ordinary passports generally must be biometric. Any applicable Latvian travel-declaration obligation is additional and is not entry permission.

policies.label: Visa required; Latvian applications restricted
policies.n: A visa is required. Cabinet Regulation 123 restricts Latvian acceptance of Belarusian visa applications to enumerated long-stay, qualifying family, humanitarian, transport, seafarer, diplomatic or individually authorised national-interest/international-obligation categories; ordinary standalone tourist applications are not included. This is a visa-processing restriction, not the Russian external-border entry ban: the MFA expressly says that travel restriction is not applied to Belarusian citizens. An independently valid Schengen visa can affect entry, but none is assumed and a newly obtainable tourist visa is not promised. Permitted stay is as authorised. A Latvian-issued visa exempts the holder from the declaration; otherwise applicable pre-arrival declaration must be submitted 48 hours ahead. Regulation 123 is currently in force through 31 December 2026.
ETA required before travel for ordinary short tourism, unless personally exempt; ETA is not a visa or permission to enter.
Hong Kong SAR passport required; other travel-document classes do not inherit this exemption.
Macao SAR passport required; other travel-document classes do not inherit this exemption.
Taiwan passport must contain the national identification-card number; otherwise an advance visit visa is required.
Irish citizens have Common Travel Area rights to enter, live and work; not a six-month visitor waiver.

Advance visitor entry clearance required. The Nicaragua/St Lucia ETA transitional exception ended on 16 April 2026. Organised French/German school-party exceptions are separate from ordinary independent tourism.
Ordinance 255: one full year. This is not 360 days or a guessed number of days.

New visits: one full year under the 2025 amendment. Ukrainians already present after entry before 24 February 2025 have a separate transitional stay extended to 24 February 2027 under Ordinance 80/2026; that date is not the expiry of the general waiver.
Tourism-only 30-day exemption in Ordinance 359/2023. Ordinary PRC passport; SAR documents are not inferred.

Temporary entry through international road and rail checkpoints. Total visa-free stay cannot exceed 90 days in a calendar year. Transit to Russia is excluded. Airport exemption is a separate regime with its own entry/exit conditions.

Enter and leave only via Minsk, Brest, Gomel, Grodno, Mogilev or Vitebsk airport checkpoints. Flights to/from Russia excluded. Passport valid at least 90 days beyond departure, funds and medical insurance of at least EUR 10,000 required. Registration after ten working days.

Single-entry tourist eVisa issued for a period not exceeding 30 days; stay duration is not separately established here. Entry through international checkpoints, but eVisa entry directly from Russia is technically unavailable. Apply at least seven calendar days ahead.

US passport exempt under Annex 3. Decision 124/2022 permits entry and stay without a residence permit for up to one year. A new one-year period requires more than 90 days outside Albania; a short border trip does not reset the allowance.

Treaty Article 1: no more than 90 calendar days during any 365-day period from first entry. The treaty also refers to Schengen counting rules for Kazakh visitors. No conversion to a per-visit reset. Entry through international checkpoints.
Tourism only, passport required; exemption runs 15 April–31 December 2026. General short-stay ceiling remains 90 days within 180 days.

Decision 858 II.A.3(c) explicitly exempts citizens who enter and stay in Schengen countries without a visa, for up to 90 days in 180. Current Latvian and German government ordinary-passport schedules identify this nationality as exempt. This is a nationality-based provision, not an assumed third-country visa/residence permit.

Visa-required Annex 4, including its explicit other-nationalities row. Decision II.A.7 permits electronic visa issuance emailed after approval, or an embassy sticker visa; applications must be made from outside Albania. Where no designated mission is listed, MFA approval of application transfer is required. Actual stay follows the issued visa, within the general C-visa 90/180 ceiling.
Belarus visa-waiver agreement suspended by Decision 236/2025, superseding the old Annex 3 entry. Advance eVisa or embassy visa under Decision 858; do not apply a legacy 30-day waiver.

Iranian citizens are specifically excluded from Decision II.A.3 substitute-visa/residence exemptions. The free-fee label in older schedules was not visa freedom. Advance electronic or consular visa; stay as issued.

Decision 470/2024 suspends the Guyana agreement for ordinary as well as diplomatic/service passports, with immediate effect. Advance electronic or consular visa under Decision 858. A blank or zero visa-fee cell is not a visa waiver; stay follows the issued visa.

Article 11(2): Hong Kong/Macao SAR passports, or Taiwan passport containing the personal identification-card number. Up to 90 days in six months under that specific provision; no assumed Schengen visa.
Specific treaty provision: 90 days, total no more than 180 days annually from first entry.
Article 13 ordinary-passport exemption: up to 90 days; no different aggregate period is stated there.
Ordinary-passport treaty exemption: 30 days within each 60-day period from first entry.
Ordinary-passport treaty exemption: 30 days within two months from first entry; months are not converted to guessed days.

2026 temporary exemption allowed a total of 60 days only during 1 June–30 September 2026; it has expired. Bahrain/Oman permanent exemptions were previously removed. An advance visa is required now; ordinary tourist arrival issuance is not established.
Article 24: Kosovo-marked travel documents require an advance visa issued on a separate form under a special procedure, not a visa sticker in the passport.

MFA ordinary-passport entry: Без виз по дипломатическим и служебным паспортам – до 90 дней. Безвизовой режим: для сотрудников, аккредитованных в Госпротоколе МИД России; по общегражданским паспортам – 30 дней из 60. Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

MFA ordinary-passport entry: Без виз по дипломатическим и служебным паспортам – до 30 дней. Без виз по общегражданским паспортам – до 30 дней (до 31.12.2027 г.). Могут въезжать по электронной визе на срок до 30 дней. Безвизовой режим: для сотрудников, аккредитованных в Госпротоколе МИД России; для членов поездных бригад; для членов экипажей морских и речных судов; для членов экипажей воздушных судов; для туристических групп в составе от 5 до 50 чел. (по заверенным спискам и подтверждениям российских турорганизаций о приеме) – до 15 дней; по карточкам АТЭС с обозначением «RUS». Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.

Без виз до 14 дней для постоянных жителей САР Гонконг КНР при наличии действительного паспорта САР Гонконг КНР. Без виз по карточкам АТЭС с обозначением «RUS». HK/MO require permanent-resident status and the corresponding SAR passport.
Без виз до 30 дней для постоянных жителей САР Макао КНР при наличии действительного паспорта САР Макао КНР. HK/MO require permanent-resident status and the corresponding SAR passport.

Безвизовой режим: по общегражданским паспортам – до 60 дней; для сотрудников, аккредитованных в Госпротоколе МИД России; по карточкам АТЭС с обозначением «RUS». Tourist scope excludes diplomatic accreditation, crew, APEC and border-resident exceptions. Aggregate period is not inferred where the table gives only a number of days.
Без виз до 14 дней.
Unified eVisa: 30-day permitted stay within 120-day validity; approved border checkpoints only. Arrival/departure days count; apply 86 to 4 days ahead; passport and insurance conditions apply.

Bilateral exemption explicitly listed for up to 60 days from border crossing.
Named 10-day exemption requires a flight ticket to the home country or a third country. Do not confuse the short waiver with an electronic visa or its longer validity.

Visa-free route: up to 10 days with qualifying onward/return air ticket. Separate advance eVisa is available for Hong Kong under Appendix 1 and allows up to 30 days under the eVisa law. The two methods have different stays.
policies.stay: Visa-free: 10 days; eVisa: up to 30 days

policies.n: 30 days per visit, total no more than 90 days within any 180-day period. Work/study/media and other specially authorised activities excluded. Do not extend this treaty to SAR passports.
US nationals: visa-free up to 30 days from entry, effective 1 January 2026; replaces the old age-55 limitation.
30 days from entry under Decree UP-86, effective 5 June 2023. Its amendment expressly removes Qatar from the earlier ten-day rule, resolving the outdated MFA footnote.

Current consolidated decree establishes visa freedom for 30 days from entry, effective 15 March 2024. Old eVisa-list inclusion is superseded; the current clause is used rather than a 2022 announcement.

Named electronic-visa eligibility. eVisa law: up to 30 days from first entry within 90-day issuance validity; single, double and multiple entries are distinct options and do not reset the first-entry stay window. Apply at least three working days before travel. No third-country visa is assumed.

Explicit MFA default: entry visa required outside the named exemptions. Consular issuance uses Uzbek-side invitation/confirmation; approved airport issuance depends on absence of a mission and prior confirmation, not unconditional arrival eligibility. Under-16 guardian-dependent exception is separate. The source does not resolve every newer application-method restriction.
policies.label: Visa required; application method unverified

policies.n: Visa required under the explicit default. Collection at Minsk National Airport requires an inviting party to submit original support documents at least two business days before arrival and a stamped receipt for airline check-in. Not available on flights from Russia. Embassy issuance is an alternative. Stay follows the issued visa; no generic 90 days is assigned.

State Migration Service entry visa and approved invitation required. Embassy tourist instructions require a Turkmen tourist-agency invitation, insurance, flight ticket and hotel reservation; they expressly permit any visa type to be collected at the border after invitation approval, or at a mission. Confirm the specified border point with the inviting agency. Registration within three working days. Stay depends on approval. eVisa launch/eligibility is not established.

British citizen passport: up to 180 days for a direct El Salvador tourist/business visit. The same source separately gives a 90-day CA-4 regional allowance; do not transfer the 180-day national permission to neighbouring countries or reset the regional clock at borders.

Category B/C nationalities may obtain advance online PEI approval instead of a consular/consulted visa. DGME describes eligibility for people lacking the required visa or unable to obtain it through a consulate, including absence of a consulate or force-majeure circumstances. Obtain approval before travel; the special permit is stamped on arrival at air, land or sea borders. This border stamp is a sequential step, not visa on arrival. DGME reports up to 180 days, subject to the grant; this is El Salvador permission, not a fresh CA-4 regional allowance. Conventional consular visa remains an alternative. The 180-day statement applies to PEI only; this audit has not established an identical allowance for the consular alternative.
policies.label: Online special entry permit (PEI)
policies.stay: PEI: up to 180 days as granted; consular visa: as separately issued

British visitors need a Honduran visa; CA-4 entry elsewhere does not remove that requirement. FCDO reports a 30-day visit stamp. Cruise passengers have a docking-hours short pass. Some British children of Honduran parents have a documented exception.
British citizen passport; 90-day CA-4 regional clock does not restart at a border. Complete the online immigration declaration; it is not a visa/eTA.
British citizen passport; 90-day CA-4 regional limit, not a fresh allowance at each border. Onward ticket may be required; USD10 arrival tax is not a visa.
Hong Kong SAR passport holders may visit Nicaragua visa-free up to 30 days under the July 27, 2026 official notification.

Group 1: visa-free tourism, up to 180 calendar days, non-extendable; officer fixes actual stay. Passport valid through stay. Return/onward ticket and funds of at least USD100 per month/partial month required.

Group 2: visa-free tourism. Duration is unresolved: embassy checker says 90 days but ICT tourism guidance says 30 days. Confirm granted period; no numerical stay asserted. Return/onward ticket and funds of at least USD100 per month/partial month required.

Group 2: visa-free tourism. Duration is unresolved: embassy checker says 90 days but ICT tourism guidance says 30 days. Confirm granted period; no numerical stay asserted. Return/onward ticket and funds of at least USD100 per month/partial month required. Passport may be used up to expiry under the stated exception.

Group 2: visa-free tourism. Duration is unresolved: embassy checker says 90 days but ICT tourism guidance says 30 days. Confirm granted period; no numerical stay asserted. Return/onward ticket and funds of at least USD100 per month/partial month required. Embassy checker requires a police antecedents certificate (without apostille).

Group 3: consular visa required without the qualifying third-country visa/residence exception. Authorized duration is determined on approval/admission; no eVisa method is established. Return/onward ticket and funds of at least USD100 per month/partial month required.

Visa-free tourist entry. Embassy states a maximum of three months. Passport must have at least three months validity; return ticket and at least USD500 solvency evidence required.
Visa-free tourist entry. Resolution 22706 of September 2021 permits up to 180 days. Passport must have at least three months validity; return ticket and at least USD500 solvency evidence required.

Authorized visa required absent a qualifying third-country document; embassy requires in-person application. Duration depends on the permission issued. The October 2024 amendment removes the earlier six-month-validity/prior-use wording for the third-country visa exemption; that exemption is not assumed.
Stamped visa required absent a qualifying third-country document. If granted, personal attendance is required for stamping. No stay length inferred from processing time or visa validity.

Apply for Cuba tourist eVisa before travel. Enter the ten-character visa code in DViajeros to generate the QR code required by airline/border control. DViajeros is a sequential declaration, not an alternative visa. Onward/return travel required. Source also mentions consular tourist cards; transition cut-off not independently settled.

Canadian tourists need a tourist visa for an initial 90 days. Electronic visa required in advance when travelling via a third country; direct-Canada packages may include the visa. DViajeros QR code and medical insurance required. Extension needed beyond 90 days; six months is not the initial allowance.

Cuban tourism authority expressly exempts Chinese citizens travelling with regular passports. No numerical visa-free stay is specified for this exemption; the separate 90-day tourist-visa rule is not automatically assigned.

Nationality appears on an explicit official visa-exempt list. Actual leave to land is set by the immigration officer; return/onward ticket, sufficient funds, six-month passport validity and arrival card required.

Bolivian regular passport is expressly listed as eligible for tourist visa on arrival. Applies where unable to apply at a local mission; six-month passport, onward/return ticket, accommodation/sponsor and original approval documents required. Granted stay not specified; financial evidence for 30 days is not a 30-day admission entitlement.

Ordinary/national passports require an approved visa BEFORE travel from 1 October 2026; official notice directs applicants to the eVisa portal. Diplomatic/service exceptions do not apply. Measure temporary but no expiry date stated; stay not specified.
Ordinary-passport visitors. The schedule does not assign a general stay to every nationality.
Inbound foreign-national column and Barbados-specific remarks; onward/outbound column not used. Unspecified stay remains 0.

Enhanced cooperation effective 1 October 2025 permits citizens of Barbados, Belize, Dominica and Saint Vincent to enter, leave, live and work indefinitely without work permit or CSME skills certificate. Public-safety/public-purse admissibility exceptions remain. Not a blanket CARICOM rule. Nationality must be established with the traveller’s own valid national document; this is not a status available merely by holding another participating country’s residence permit. No CSME skills certificate is required for these four-state rights.

Short tourist visit; no remunerated activity. Admission cannot exceed the travel-document expiry. Checker lists different single-entry and multiple-entry periods; do not assume the longer period on an ordinary single visit.
Canadian ordinary passport: tourist visa not required. Passport valid at least six months beyond expected departure. No stay length specified.
Canadian ordinary-passport visa exemption is explicit. Source duration remark says six (6) without a unit; no duration inferred.

Canadian ordinary passport: tourist visa not required for up to 90 days per 12-month period; extension must be requested. Additional land/river border documentation and Galapagos controls remain distinct.
Canadian ordinary passport: tourist visa not required; passport valid at least six months beyond expected departure. Stay duration unspecified.

Explicitly named in the Tourism Authority incoming visa-exempt list. China/Cuba limited to 30 days; other stay periods are not supplied by this page. Ordinary passport; no third-country visa/residence assumed.
Ordinary-passport tourist/visit exemption.

Short tourist visit; no remunerated activity. Admission cannot exceed the travel-document expiry. Advance consular authorization/visa required. Tourist visa is issued electronically after the 100% virtual process. Authorized stay 90 days, extendable by 90; maximum 180 continuous/discontinuous days in 365 counted from visa issue. Visa validity up to one year is not stay. No qualifying foreign visa/residence is assumed. The named foreign-visa/residence exemption is conditional, not assumed.

Si/No is conditional on specified valid foreign visas or permanent residence; without those documents a tourist visa is required. The printed 180 days applies to that conditional exemption, not a guaranteed visa stay.

Ordinary passport column. Stay unspecified unless a numbered footnote supplies it. Prior authorization is required. Inbound foreign-national column and Barbados-specific remarks; onward/outbound column not used. Unspecified stay remains 0.

Germany is explicitly named in the embassy inbound exemption list; stay unspecified.

Associate members are not included.
Ordinary passport column. Stay unspecified unless a numbered footnote supplies it.

Short tourist visit; no remunerated activity. Admission cannot exceed the travel-document expiry. British citizen passport; other British classes require separate document review.
British citizen ordinary passport only. Duration remains subject to border permission; no other British nationality class assumed.

British citizen ordinary passport only. Duration remains subject to border permission; no other British nationality class assumed.
British citizen ordinary passport only. Normally 30 days; one-month extensions must be requested.

British citizen ordinary passport only. Duration remains subject to border permission; no other British nationality class assumed.

Short tourist visit; no remunerated activity. Admission cannot exceed the travel-document expiry. Visa waiver applies only to a single-entry visit, maximum 60 days.

Visa on arrival only at Silvio Pettirossi International Airport (Asunción-Luque), without prior application; passport valid at least six months and applicable fee in cash. Other arrival ports are not covered by this rule. Stay is the nationality-specific arrival allowance.

Ordinary passport column. Stay unspecified unless a numbered footnote supplies it.

Visa on arrival only at Silvio Pettirossi International Airport (Asunción-Luque), without prior application; passport valid at least six months and applicable fee in cash. Other arrival ports are not covered by this rule. Stay is the nationality-specific arrival allowance.

Serbian ordinary passport: visa-free up to 90 days within 180 days. Origin-government advice applies only to Serbian nationals.

Source explicitly says nationals not in the list require a prior consular visa. Electronic-method availability is not established.

Visit visa required. This nationality schedule does not establish the available electronic application method. Taiwan: visit visa may be valid up to five years, with stays of 90 days; validity is not stay length.

Ordinary passport column. Stay unspecified unless a numbered footnote supplies it. Travel certificate required since 5 December 2018; ordinary consular visa label alone is insufficient. Electronic-method availability is not determined by this schedule.

Ordinary-passport tourism, up to 60 days. Listed Mercosur travel documents may substitute for passports only within the applicable arrangements; nationality-based visa requirements, stay limits and Venezuela/Brazil implementation exceptions persist. This is not unrestricted residence/work movement.

Tourism waiver is conditional on permanent residence in Chile, Colombia or Mexico; no such residence assumed. Do not use the Si/No cell as unconditional exemption.
Kosovo is explicitly visa-required in the May 2025 inbound column. No exemption inferred from recognition status; stay and fully electronic issuance not established.

Visit visa required. This nationality schedule does not establish the available electronic application method. No diplomatic relations; ordinary visit visas may be issued for a period up to 90 days, but this wording is not treated as a guaranteed stay. Non-recognition is not an entry prohibition.

Ordinary passport valid throughout intended stay; tourism permitted. 30 calendar days from day after entry. Temporary/emergency/travel documents excluded. This unilateral program has no stated aggregate-day cap in the current MFA FAQ; not a 90-day-per-visit allowance. Use a port open to foreign nationals.
Ordinary-passport bilateral visa waiver; NIA explicitly gives 30-day stay in China. No separate rolling aggregate is invented where this row does not state one.

For ordinary independent tourism, apply for an advance visa under Article 15; approved duration is stated on the visa. No general nationality waiver established after reconciling unilateral, bilateral and regional lists. Genuine alternative: organised/received tourist cruise group of 2+ at the 13 authorised port cities, same ship/itinerary throughout and departure, maximum 15 days in Beijing and 11 coastal provinces/regions. Other group/urgent-port/transit concessions have separate conditions; no unconditional VOA is asserted.
policies.stay: Independent tourist visa:as issued; qualifying organised cruise group:up to 15 days

policies.n: Ordinary-passport bilateral waiver: up to 30 days per visit, cumulative no more than 90 visa-free days within any rolling 180-day period. Remaining aggregate allowance may shorten a visit.
Ordinary-passport bilateral waiver: no more than 90 days within any 180-day period. This aggregate also constrains repeat visits; it is not a fresh 90 days on each entry.
Ordinary passport; bilateral waiver effective 2025-07-16 for up to 30 days per visit, cumulative 90 in any 180 days. Longer stays/work/study/media require an appropriate visa.

Ordinary passport valid throughout intended stay; tourism permitted. 30 calendar days from day after entry. Temporary/emergency/travel documents excluded. This unilateral program has no stated aggregate-day cap in the current MFA FAQ; not a 90-day-per-visit allowance. Use a port open to foreign nationals. MFA states no expiry for Brunei.
Ordinary-passport bilateral waiver: 30 days per visit, cumulative no more than 90 days per year.

Ordinary Cuban tourist requires an advance visa; exemption from consular fees is not visa-free admission. Submit printed application and passport; stay determined by consular officer. Cuban diplomatic/official/service 60-day waiver is outside ordinary-passport scope. Eligible organised cruise groups have the separately conditioned 15-day regional waiver.
policies.stay: Ordinary tourist visa:as issued; qualifying organised cruise group:up to 15 days

Qualifying agency cruise groups have a separate 15-day regional exemption and must remain on the same cruise itinerary. Transit exemptions require onward travel to a third country/region and are not ordinary destination-only admission.
policies.stay: Hainan-only:30 days; qualifying cruise group:15 days; regular visa:as issued

policies.n: Bilateral ordinary-passport waiver: 60 days under the amended agreement; not the older 30-day allowance.

Malaysian ordinary passport valid at least six months. Tourism waiver 30 days per entry, subject to cumulative 90 visa-free days in any rolling 180 days; remaining aggregate allowance can shorten a visit. Complete accommodation registration. Renewable treaty term is not encoded as an expiry.

Ordinary passport valid throughout intended stay; tourism permitted. 30 calendar days from day after entry. Temporary/emergency/travel documents excluded. This unilateral program has no stated aggregate-day cap in the current MFA FAQ; not a 90-day-per-visit allowance. Use a port open to foreign nationals. Current central MFA extension supersedes older embassy FAQ expiry.
Valid ordinary passport under bilateral waiver. NIA states within three months; do not convert calendar months into 90 days.

Taiwan residents require a Mainland Travel Permit. Obtain in advance, or apply for a single-entry permit at one of the 100 designated ports under NIA’s 2025-11-20 measure; issue/entry subject to approval. Taiwan passport alone is insufficient; the on-arrival permit is not unrestricted visa-free entry.
policies.label: Mainland travel permit; designated-port option

policies.n: Mutual waiver from 2025-06-01: up to 30 days per visit and 90 in any 180-day period; tourism permitted. Does not cover Hong Kong or Macao.
Ordinary-passport visitor entry; adequate funds and onward or return travel are required. Work and study need separate permission.
Ordinary-passport visitor entry; adequate funds and onward or return travel are required. Work and study need separate permission.

Immigration accepts online applications and issues an e-Visa after approval/payment; postal or mission application is also possible. Adequate funds and travel itinerary required. No fixed stay is asserted; approval is discretionary.
policies.label: Advance visitor e-Visa

policies.n: Ordinary-passport visitor entry; adequate funds and onward or return travel are required. Work and study need separate permission. Visa-free entry applies only to biometric passports; other passports require a visa.
Ordinary-passport visitor entry; adequate funds and onward or return travel are required. Work and study need separate permission.

For tourism, Mainland residents require an Exit-entry Permit with the appropriate endorsement; overseas PRC passport holders require an entry permit. A PRC passport alone provides a seven-day TRANSIT concession, not an unrestricted tourist waiver.

180 days applies to British citizens only. British Overseas Territories citizens, Overseas citizens, subjects and Protected persons have a 90-day allowance. Adequate funds and onward/return travel required.

Successful pre-arrival registration (PAR) is required before travel. Passport validity must be at least six months. The six-month PAR validity is not the stay limit: each visit is up to 14 days. Carry the signed printed notification slip and the same passport. If PAR fails, apply directly to Immigration for a visa. Valid frequent-visitor e-Channel enrollment, HKSAR Travel Pass and other expressly listed exemptions have separate conditions.

Requires eligible Macao smart permanent ID, or Visit Permit for Macao residents together with proof of permanent residence. SAR passport alone only supports the separate seven-day transit concession. Non-permanent Visit Permit holders receive up to 30 days.

14-day waiver only for Serbian biometric passports NOT issued by the Coordination Directorate in Belgrade. Non-biometric and Coordination Directorate passports require a visa. Adequate funds and onward/return travel required.
Explicit residual rule for nationals of other foreign countries: seven-day visit. Valid accepted passport, adequate funds and onward/return travel required.

Ordinary-passport visitor entry; adequate funds and onward or return travel are required. Work and study need separate permission. Tongan National and Protected Persons passports have a separate visa requirement.
Ordinary-passport visitor entry; adequate funds and onward or return travel are required. Work and study need separate permission. Passports stating national status as I-TUVALU require a visa.

Taiwan-resident PAR requires birth in Taiwan or a previous admission as a Taiwan resident, no other foreign travel document except permitted Mainland/HK permits, and a Taiwan re-entry document valid six months. Carry printed signed PAR; two-month registration allows two visits of 30 days each. Ineligible applicants need an entry permit.
Ordinary US passport only; diplomatic passports have a separate visa requirement. Adequate funds and onward/return travel required.
90-day waiver excludes Uruguay passports issued under Decree 289/90, which require a visa. Adequate funds and onward/return travel required.
Tourist visit; passport valid at least 90 days beyond intended stay. Sufficient funds and onward/return ticket required unless an explicit residence-based exemption applies.
Tourist visit; passport valid at least 90 days beyond intended stay. Sufficient funds and onward/return ticket required unless an explicit residence-based exemption applies.

Apply for an Entry Permit (visa-upon-arrival) at the border checkpoint; grant is discretionary, maximum 30 days. Tourist visit; passport valid at least 90 days beyond intended stay. Sufficient funds and onward/return ticket required unless an explicit residence-based exemption applies.

Must obtain a Macao visa in advance through a Chinese embassy/consulate; not eligible for the general visa-upon-arrival route. Unless the issued permission specifies otherwise, the stay on entry is a maximum of 30 days. Tourist visit; passport valid at least 90 days beyond intended stay. Sufficient funds and onward/return ticket required unless an explicit residence-based exemption applies.
Tourist visit; passport valid at least 90 days beyond intended stay. Sufficient funds and onward/return ticket required unless an explicit residence-based exemption applies.

Tourist visit; passport valid at least 90 days beyond intended stay. Sufficient funds and onward/return ticket required unless an explicit residence-based exemption applies.

British citizens holding a British passport only. Tourist visit; passport valid at least 90 days beyond intended stay. Sufficient funds and onward/return ticket required unless an explicit residence-based exemption applies.
One-year visitor permission requires a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card or Re-entry Permit. An HKSAR passport alone has only the separate seven-day onward-transit concession.
policies.stay: Up to 1 year with Hong Kong Permanent ID or Re-entry Permit

policies.n: Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.

Apply for and obtain eVisa before travel; passport valid six months, carry printed approval. Single entry, maximum stay 30 days; three-month visa validity is the entry window. Ordinary passports; no third-country visa/residence assumed.

Not covered by the ordinary-passport visa waiver or unrestricted tourist eVisa lists. BOCA directs ineligible eVisa applicants to an ROC overseas mission for a visitor visa. Official-event/Ecode, business recommendations and third-country-document concessions are not assumed. Stay follows the visa issued.

Without a qualifying US/Schengen visa/residence or official invitation/Ecode, apply through an ROC overseas mission. The conditional eVisa concession must not be treated as ordinary nationality-only tourist eligibility. Stay follows issued permission.

Ordinary passports; accommodation booking, host/contact details and sufficient funds required. Not applicable to joining crew. Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.

Ineligible if passport birthplace is Afghanistan, Iran, Iraq, Libya, Nigeria, Pakistan, PRC, Syria or Yemen. Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.

GB means British citizen only. Initial visa-exempt entry is 90 days; a further extension up to 180 days is an application, not automatic initial admission. Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.
Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.

Ineligible if passport birthplace is PRC. Ordinary passports only. Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.

Tourist eVisa only for a qualifying group tour through a Tourism Administration-designated agency under the high-end group tourist project; independent visitors need a conventional visitor visa unless another exemption applies. policies.n: Passport need only be valid for intended stay. Confirmed departure required; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.

Only the source-defined Marshallese citizens at birth qualify; not an unrestricted waiver for all naturalized passport holders. Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.
Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.

Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival. An eVisa is also available for stays up to 30 days; its three-month validity is not stay.

Ordinary passports eligible for eVisa 2026-07-07 through 2027-07-06. This is an eVisa eligibility window, not a visa exemption expiry. Single-entry stay up to 30 days; visa validity three months; passport valid six months and printed approval required.

Ineligible if passport birthplace is Afghanistan, Iran, Iraq, Libya, Nigeria, Pakistan, PRC, Syria or Yemen. Ordinary passport; confirmed departure required. Generally six-month passport validity; TWAC online arrival card within seven days before arrival. Stay begins the day after arrival.
Short visits only. The initial stay is counted from landing permission.

Short visits only. The initial stay is counted from landing permission. Stays beyond the initial 90 days require an extension before the permitted stay expires; a six-month bilateral arrangement is not automatic six-month admission.

Visa waiver for holders of an ICAO-compliant machine-readable passport. Holders of other passports are advised to obtain a visa in advance; otherwise they face strict examination and may be refused. Initial landing permission is 90 days.
Short visits only. The initial stay is counted from landing permission.

Chinese ordinary passport and residence in China; apply through accredited agency. Tourist eVisa stay 15 or 30 days, not generic 90. Regular visa remains a separate alternative with duration as issued. Display live Visa issuance notice.

Short visits only. The initial stay is counted from landing permission. Applies to Hong Kong SAR passports or eligible BNO passports with the right of residence in Hong Kong.

For Indonesia-resident applicants who are not exempt, accredited-agency tourist eVisa is a genuine alternative up to 90 days. The registration and eVisa are alternatives, not sequential steps.

Short visits only. The initial stay is counted from landing permission. Applies to Macao SAR passports.

Visa waiver for an ICAO-compliant ePassport. Holders of other passports are advised to obtain an advance visa; otherwise they face strict examination and may be refused. Initial landing permission is 90 days.

No third-country residence is assumed and stay depends on the visa issued. Visa waiver requires an ICAO-compliant ePassport. Other passports require a visa in advance; MOFA says entry will otherwise be refused. Short tourism only; duration is initial landing permission.
Short visits only. The initial stay is counted from landing permission. Passport must contain a personal identity number.

Short visits only. The initial stay is counted from landing permission. Japan does not recognise the new Uruguayan passport version without place of birth. The waiver applies to the recognised old passport version.

Australian ordinary traveller requires an advance DPRK visa, official tour and guide. Obtain from a DPRK mission abroad; no Australian mission available. Current border/tour availability must be confirmed; visa requirement is not proof that tourism is presently open.

Canadian ordinary traveller requires tourist visa from DPRK mission abroad after Pyongyang approval. Passport valid 6 months beyond planned departure; official guide and severe travel/border restrictions. No general open-tourism assurance.

British citizen passport: advance North Korean visa required; ordinary tourism normally organised tour, independent travel requires sponsor and MFA permission. General-entry border restrictions remain reported; visa requirement does not establish current tour/admission availability. Stay not specified.
Short tourist visits only. Obtain K-ETA before boarding unless personally exempt (including age 17 or younger, or 65 or older, on entry). Three-year authorisation validity is not the stay allowance.
Short tourist visits only. Obtain K-ETA before boarding unless personally exempt (including age 17 or younger, or 65 or older, on entry). Three-year authorisation validity is not the stay allowance.

Short tourist visits only. K-ETA temporarily not required through 2026-12-31 (KST); this expiry concerns authorisation, not the underlying visa waiver. Complete the applicable arrival declaration unless exempt.

Short tourist visits only. K-ETA temporarily not required through 2026-12-31 (KST); this expiry concerns authorisation, not the underlying visa waiver. Complete the applicable arrival declaration unless exempt.

Short tourist visits only. Obtain K-ETA before boarding unless personally exempt (including age 17 or younger, or 65 or older, on entry). Three-year authorisation validity is not the stay allowance.

Short tourist visits only. K-ETA temporarily not required through 2026-12-31 (KST); this expiry concerns authorisation, not the underlying visa waiver. Complete the applicable arrival declaration unless exempt. British citizen passport; other British passport classes have a separate 30-day entry.

Short tourist visits only. K-ETA temporarily not required through 2026-12-31 (KST); this expiry concerns authorisation, not the underlying visa waiver. Complete the applicable arrival declaration unless exempt. SAR passport; other travel documents require a separate check.

Short tourist visits only. Obtain K-ETA before boarding unless personally exempt (including age 17 or younger, or 65 or older, on entry). Three-year authorisation validity is not the stay allowance.
